description: Road network data of East Rapti Watershed is a data set deposited in icimod.rds by its authors ICIMOD. Road network data of East Rapti Watershed of road layer is generated by digitizing on Google Earth in order to develop an application for post flood response support. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2015. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC-BY-4.0). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
